content: Windows OpenSSH: config %programdata%\ssh\sshd_config; admins use administrators_authorized_keys (ACL only SYSTEM+Administrators); names lowercase; domain users NameSamCompatible domain\user; AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand/AuthorizedKeysCommand unsupported; Entra ID admins skip Match Group (issue #2466). Inbox version on Win11 is 9.5p2; Win32-OpenSSH latest 10.0p2 preview.
